parsed.answer: Per the memory, Atlas production deploys require approval from Mira Okafor, the Atlas release owner (record atlas-deploy-approval, verified). The migration lock timeout is 45 seconds: Atlas database migrations take an advisory lock, and the migration lock timeout is 45 seconds (record atlas-migration-lock, verified). The memory has no separate migration-specific approval rule, so the deploy approver is the general production-deploy approver.
